description: This file defines the 'ContentBottom' controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically in the Catalog module under the Common namespace. The class extends a base Controller class and implements an 'index' method that loads and renders content modules assigned to the bottom section of a page, based on the current route and layout configuration.

classes.name: ContentBottom
classes.description: Controller class responsible for rendering the content bottom section of pages, dynamically loading modules based on route and layout configurations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that determines the current route, loads relevant models, retrieves module configurations, loads modules, and renders the 'common/content_bottom' view.
